inputs.prompt: Identify the object outlined in yellow. The outline is not part of the object. Reply with only a short noun phrase of at most 8 words. Do not mention the outline.

Describe the subject outlined in yellow and the scene for a video prompt. Return only JSON with these string fields. style: a short visual style, such as "Live-action, cinematic" or "3D animation". subject: a short lowercase noun phrase starting with "the", such as "the brown dog". motion_verb: one present-tense verb for how the subject moves, agreeing with the subject, such as "walks", "rolls" or "fly". scene: a short lowercase phrase starting with a preposition that places the subject, such as "on a sunlit lawn beside a fence"; not a full sentence. soundscape: one sentence of audible natural ambient sounds and subject sounds appropriate to the scene when animated. Do not describe silence just because the input is a still image. If unsure, use Natural ambient sounds from the scene. The outline is not part of the scene; do not mention it. Do not invent dialogue or music.
